* A utility wrapper that abstracts operations on the underlying native SSL_SESSION instance. *

* This is abstract only to support mocking for tests.

methods.name: static NativeSslSession newInstance(NativeRef.SSL_SESSION ref, ConscryptSession session) throws SSLPeerUnverifiedException
methods.comment:
* Creates a new instance. Since BoringSSL does not provide an API to get access to all
     * session information via the SSL_SESSION, we get some values (e.g. peer certs) from
     * the {@link ConscryptSession} instead (i.e. the SSL object).

methods.name: static NativeSslSession newInstance(AbstractSessionContext context, byte[] data, String host, int port)
methods.comment:
* Creates a new {@link NativeSslSession} instance from the provided serialized bytes, which
     * were generated by {@link #toBytes()}.
     *
     * @return The new instance if successful. If unable to parse the bytes for any reason, returns
     * {@code null}.

methods.name: abstract boolean isSingleUse()
methods.comment: * Returns whether this session should only ever be used for resumption once.

methods.name: abstract void offerToResume(NativeSsl ssl) throws SSLException
abstract byte[] getPeerOcspStapledResponse()
methods.comment: * Returns the OCSP stapled response. The returned array is not copied; the caller must * either not modify the returned array or make a copy. * * @see RFC 6066 * @see RFC 6961

methods.name: abstract byte[] getPeerSignedCertificateTimestamp()
methods.comment: * Returns the signed certificate timestamp (SCT) received from the peer. The returned array * is not copied; the caller must either not modify the returned array or make a copy. * * @see RFC 6962

methods.name: abstract byte[] toBytes()
methods.comment:
* Converts the given session to bytes.
     *
     * @return session data as bytes or null if the session can't be converted

methods.name: abstract SSLSession toSSLSession()
methods.comment:
* Converts this object to a {@link SSLSession}. The returned session will support only a
     * subset of the {@link SSLSession} API.

methods.name: private static void checkRemaining(ByteBuffer buf, int length) throws IOException
